primary_invariant: Restore must be deterministic and physical payload metadata must resolve to valid bytes.
Verify must fail closed on corrupted or inconsistent catalog/storage state.
notes: Includes payload hash, packed refs, legacy blocks, and repository verification.

primary_invariant: Maintenance must not delete or legitimize reachable/corrupt data.
GC must never delete snapshot-reachable or current-live data.
notes: Includes reachability plans and delete eligibility.

primary_invariant: Snapshots must remain immutable roots for restore and retention.
Recovery must fail closed and must not legitimize corrupt mappings.
Schema bootstrap and migration must preserve catalog semantics across backends.
Catalog graph traversal must preserve reachability semantics.
notes: Supports GC, snapshot, stats, inspect, and verify.

primary_invariant: Packed and legacy block abstractions must remain semantically aligned.
notes: Supports packed block metadata and payload access.

primary_invariant: Container reads/writes must preserve payload integrity and placement bounds.
Retention policies must preserve required snapshots and roots.
CLI/JSON contracts must remain stable where automation depends on them.
notes: Do not gate globally in v1.10.7.

primary_invariant: Stats and inspect must reflect true repository state without mutation.
notes: Important but not initial gate target.

primary_invariant: Benchmark reports must be deterministic and schema-valid.
notes: Avoid mixing benchmark cleanup into v1.10.7 unless coverage script needs it.
